gone.text: A blood trail on the sidewalk ends at the curb. Whoever was hurt got in a car. A vendor saw nothing, loudly.

success.note: A partial plate and a direction of travel. It goes in the report.
County has a stab victim who won't give a name.

hot.text: A crowd has formed around a man down on the sidewalk. Someone points down the block: "He went that way! He's still got it!"

success.note: You kneel by the victim. The suspect is still out there.

options.text: Set a perimeter and call the airship.

success.note: The airship is twenty minutes out.

bat.text: A man with a baseball bat is pacing in front of a liquor store with its window broken. He's shaking.

options.text: Talk to him from a distance.

success.note: The Taser drops him. Cuffs, an ambulance check, a report.

bat_talk.text: The bat hits the sidewalk. The store owner says the man's brother was shot here last month.

options.text: Get the owner to take a report and let it go to the DA.

success.note: A vandalism report. He goes home with his sister.
